title: Fix shotfile highlight flickering on TextChanged
description: Shot 10 (cfg): apply_syntax does clearmatches + matchaddpos on every debounced TextChanged, causing visible flicker even when matches haven't changed. Fix: compute fingerprint of match set and skip reapply if unchanged.
close_reason: Fixed shotfile highlight flickering. apply_syntax now computes a fingerprint of the match set (line:group pairs) and skips clear+reapply if unchanged. Only clears and re-adds matches when actual highlight positions change. Fingerprint is per-window (matches are window-local), reset on BufLeave. Key file: lua/shooter/syntax.lua.

title: Zero-flicker syntax: diff-based match updates instead of clear+reapply
description: Shot 11 (cfg): Replace clearmatches+matchaddpos with incremental diff. Track match IDs per window, only delete removed matches and add new ones. Unchanged matches stay in place.
close_reason: Replaced clearmatches+matchaddpos with incremental diff approach. window_matches tracks match IDs per window. apply_syntax now diffs old vs new: only matchdelete removed matches and matchaddpos new ones. Unchanged matches stay in place — zero flicker on line insert/delete. Also cleaned up redundant clearmatches in BufEnter else branch. Key file: lua/shooter/syntax.lua

title: Optimize syntax highlighting performance + day marker toggle

close_reason: Fixed O(n²) syntax highlighting in syntax.lua: replaced per-line is_in_code_block() with single O(n) build_code_block_map(), merged two loops, added 300ms debounce for TextChanged/TextChangedI, disabled day markers by default. Added ShooterFileToggleFirstShotOfDayColoring command in commands.lua and fcf keymap in keymaps.lua. Key files: lua/shooter/syntax.lua, lua/shooter/commands.lua, lua/shooter/keymaps.lua.

title: Add header description to shot creation and sending

User started putting headers on shots like `## shot 350 some header` and wanted:
1. Cursor to position at end of header line when creating new shots (so they can type a description)
2. Header description text to be included when shots are sent to AI panes

## What was done
- Modified `create_new_shot()` and `create_new_shot_with_whisper()` in `shot_actions.lua` to position cursor at end of header line using `startinsert!` (append mode) instead of on the blank line below
- Added `parse_shot_header_text()` to `shots.lua` to extract optional description text from shot headers, stripping timestamps and @refs from executed shots
- Updated `build_shot_message()` and `build_multishot_message()` in `messages.lua` to include header description in sent messages
- Added 4 tests for `parse_shot_header_text()` covering open shots, executed shots, and nil cases

## Files changed
- `lua/shooter/core/shot_actions.lua`: cursor positioning change
- `lua/shooter/core/shots.lua`: new `parse_shot_header_text()` function
- `lua/shooter/tmux/messages.lua`: include header text in sent messages
- `tests/core/shots_spec.lua`: 4 new tests

title: add hal to claude process detection
description:
## What was requested
Shot 346: The user switched from running `claude` directly to a `hal` wrapper command. The pane detection for shooter.nvim send used `ps aux | grep claude` via the provider's `process_pattern`. While `claude` still runs as a child process of `hal`, adding `hal` to the pattern ensures detection works even during hal's startup phase before claude spawns.

## What was done
Added `hal` to the Claude provider's `process_pattern` regex so both `claude` and `hal` processes are detected when looking for AI panes.

## Files changed
- `lua/shooter/providers/claude.lua:9`: Changed `process_pattern` from `'claude'` to `'claude|hal'`

## Decisions made
- Added `hal` to existing Claude provider rather than creating a separate provider, since hal is a Claude wrapper
close_reason: Added hal to claude process_pattern

title: tmux pane variable provider detection (cross-repo)
description:
## What was requested
Shot 346: hal wrapper makes all AI panes show 'hal' as foreground process, breaking shooter.nvim's ps-based provider detection. Each provider (claude/codex/gemini/opencode) sends messages differently, so correct detection is critical.

## What was done
Implemented tmux per-pane user variables (`@shooter_provider`) as the primary detection mechanism:

### hal (~/a/hal) - v0.2.47
- Added `set_tmux_pane_var()` helper that sets tmux `@`-prefixed pane variables
- `launch_agent()` now sets `@shooter_provider` to the agent name before spawning
- Variable cleared on agent exit (all paths including errors)
- No-op when not in tmux

### shooter.nvim - v0.2.35
- Added `get_all_pane_providers()` batch reader (1 tmux call for all panes)
- Updated `detect_provider_for_pane()`: tmux variable first, ps-based fallback
- Updated `get_ai_ttys()`: includes TTYs from both tmux vars and ps detection
- Updated `check_any_ai_running()`: checks tmux vars first
- Reverted `hal` from claude's `process_pattern` (no longer needed)

## Files changed
- `~/a/hal/src/cmd/git/worktree/run.rs`: Added set_tmux_pane_var(), clear_tmux_pane_vars(), wrapped launch_agent()
- `lua/shooter/providers/init.lua`: Added get_all_pane_providers(), updated 3 detection functions
- `lua/shooter/providers/claude.lua`: Reverted process_pattern to 'claude'

## Decisions made
- Used tmux per-pane `@` variables over socket files or env vars — isolated, instant, zero-cost
- Kept ps-based detection as fallback for direct agent launches (backward compat)
- Batch-read all pane variables in one tmux call for efficiency
close_reason: Implemented tmux pane variable detection across hal + shooter.nvim

title: Fix Gemini shot send stalling
description: Gemini accepts @filepath but then tries to read external bullet path via restricted workspace tool and appears stalled. Send shot file content directly for Gemini provider to avoid attachment path/tool gating.
close_reason: Implemented Gemini-specific shot send path that reads bullet file locally and sends content directly to the pane (no path attachment), avoiding workspace-read stalls and command parsing issues. Key files: lua/shooter/providers/gemini.lua, tests/providers/gemini_spec.lua, .shooter/context.md, .shooter/decisions.md. Verified with providers test suite (17 passing).
